_meta.state_of_the_world: No strategy is live. 0 of 7 passed every gate that can be evaluated, so every demotion gate below reports NOT APPLICABLE.
_meta.why_publish_unused_gates: A demotion gate written after the first live strategy exists is written under pressure and will be argued with. Publishing it first is the point.

promotion_gates.name: Pre-registration
promotion_gates.rule: The rule, its market, its thresholds and its evaluation window are committed before any result is computed.
promotion_gates.threshold: a committed file with a date
promotion_gates.statistic: present in origin_lab/leaderboard.py with constants at the top

promotion_gates.name: Causality
promotion_gates.rule: Every feature is knowable at kickoff. The ratings state is updated only after a game has been emitted.
promotion_gates.threshold: the walk-forward update is after the emit, and a leak probe detects leakage if it is not
promotion_gates.statistic: leak probe: refitting the model with the same-game margin included raises the fit R-squared to 1.0

promotion_gates.name: Sample size
promotion_gates.rule: Enough settled bets to see the edge the strategy claims, in a discovery window and a confirmation window.
promotion_gates.threshold: n >= 200 overall and n >= 100 in confirmation

promotion_gates.name: Beats the price, not a coin
promotion_gates.rule: The hit rate is tested against the breakeven implied by the prices actually taken, not against 50%.

promotion_gates.name: Multiplicity
promotion_gates.rule: The whole family of tested rules is corrected, so one lucky rule out of many cannot pass alone.
promotion_gates.threshold: Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.10 across the strategies tested in this repository

promotion_gates.name: Holdout
promotion_gates.rule: The rule is scored on a window that was never looked at while building it.

promotion_gates.name: Signal, not staking
promotion_gates.rule: The lower bound on flat-stake ROI is positive. Stake sizing cannot contribute to this number.

promotion_gates.name: Stability
promotion_gates.rule: The edge survives in most seasons, not in one good year.
promotion_gates.threshold: positive in at least 60% of seasons bet

promotion_gates.name: Price availability
promotion_gates.rule: Every bet the record contains carries a price that the snapshot store can name the source of.
promotion_gates.threshold: zero bets with a missing price in the live window
promotion_gates.statistic: count of bets whose price is blank

promotion_gates.name: Closing-line value
promotion_gates.rule: The strategy beats the closing number, which is the only test that separates a good line from a good price.
promotion_gates.threshold: mean CLV > 0 over at least 200 bets
promotion_gates.blocked_reason: CLV needs the price at the moment the bet was struck. The snapshot store holds an opening number for 272 games of 7,239, so this gate CANNOT be evaluated today. No strategy can be promoted while it is unevaluable.

demotion_gates.name: Trailing return
demotion_gates.trigger: The one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on flat-stake ROI over the trailing window falls below zero.
demotion_gates.action: Demote to paper. No new stakes until re-promotion.
demotion_gates.why_this_window: 200 bets is the shortest window in which a 3-point ROI edge has a usable chance of being separated from noise; below that the gate demotes almost everything and above it a losing strategy runs too long.

demotion_gates.name: Closing-line value turns negative
demotion_gates.trigger: Mean CLV over the trailing window is at or below zero, meaning the strategy is no longer beating the closing number even if it is winning.
demotion_gates.action: Demote. A strategy that is winning without beating the close is winning on variance.
demotion_gates.blocked_reason: Unevaluable until the price store records the number at bet time for the markets the strategy trades. This is the same gap as promotion gate P10.

demotion_gates.name: Hit rate against the price
demotion_gates.trigger: The hit rate falls more than two standard errors below the breakeven implied by the prices taken.

demotion_gates.name: Drawdown
demotion_gates.trigger: The live bankroll falls further below its peak than the pre-registered maximum.
demotion_gates.statistic: running bankroll minus running peak, in units
demotion_gates.action: Demote immediately, without waiting for the trailing window to fill.
demotion_gates.why_this_window: A drawdown limit is a solvency rule, not a significance test; it is checked continuously because a strategy can lose more than its edge before 200 bets have settled.

demotion_gates.name: Rule change
demotion_gates.trigger: The rule, any of its parameters, or its market is edited after promotion.
demotion_gates.action: Demote immediately. A changed rule is a new rule and has not been tested.

demotion_gates.name: Record integrity
demotion_gates.trigger: A live bet has no recorded price, or its result is not in the verified feed.
demotion_gates.statistic: count of live bets failing the price or result check
demotion_gates.action: Demote until the record is repaired. An unpriceable bet cannot be scored, and an unscored bet is not evidence.

demotion_gates.name: Market withdrawal
demotion_gates.trigger: The market the strategy depends on is no longer offered at a price the store can record.
demotion_gates.statistic: count of consecutive missed windows with no offered price
demotion_gates.action: Demote. A strategy that cannot be bet is not a strategy.

demotion_gates.name: Dormancy
demotion_gates.trigger: No new settled bet for longer than the dormancy window.
demotion_gates.statistic: days since the last settled live bet
demotion_gates.action: Demote to paper. A rule that has stopped firing has stopped being tested, and its promotion has expired.
